quiz.question: 「處理器資格與映射」：若要檢查結果是否可信，哪一項提供本課的獨立驗證動作？
quiz.questionEn: Eligibility and placement: Which statement provides an independent verification action for judging whether the result is credible?
options: 對相同形狀與輸入連續執行，分開首次編譯與暖機後計時，並記錄實際處理器映射。
若只首次很慢，檢查載入或編譯；若每次都慢，查轉換與邊界，不能直接歸咎神經引擎。
以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 合成CPU-only耗時9 ms；混合路徑運算4 ms，三次邊界各2 ms。
optionsEn: Run identical shapes/inputs, split compilation from warm timing, and record actual processor placement.
A slow first call suggests loading/compilation; consistently slow calls suggest boundaries or conversion.
All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Synthetic CPU-only time 9 ms; heterogeneous compute4 ms with three 2 ms boundaries.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「獨立驗證方法」。對相同形狀與輸入連續執行，分開首次編譯與暖機後計時，並記錄實際處理器映射。 與本階段判準一起判讀：把允許使用某處理器與實際映射區分，對比核心時間及完整呼叫延遲。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies independent verification. Run identical shapes/inputs, split compilation from warm timing, and record actual processor placement. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Separate allowed processors from actual placement, and compare kernel time with complete call latency.

steps.title: 處理器資格與映射 · 比較擾動與量測
steps.titleEn: Eligibility and placement · Compare perturbations and measurements
steps.objective: 完成「處理器資格與映射」的比較擾動與量測，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete compare perturbations and measurements for Eligibility and placement and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
對相同形狀與輸入連續執行，分開首次編譯與暖機後計時，並記錄實際處理器映射。
回到本階段實驗：標示各子圖的輸入布局、型別與駐留位置，圈出三次轉換。 Core ML 的compute-units選項限制可使用的處理器集合；本課研究跨處理器轉換成本。
把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：把允許使用某處理器與實際映射區分，對比核心時間及完整呼叫延遲。
steps.instructionEn:
Run identical shapes/inputs, split compilation from warm timing, and record actual processor placement.
Return to the investigation: Label layout, type and residency for each subgraph, and circle the three conversions. Core ML compute-unit settings constrain eligible processors; this lab studies transfer costs between them.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Separate allowed processors from actual placement, and compare kernel time with complete call latency.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。對相同形狀與輸入連續執行，分開首次編譯與暖機後計時，並記錄實際處理器映射。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Run identical shapes/inputs, split compilation from warm timing, and record actual processor placement.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 把允許使用某處理器與實際映射區分，對比核心時間及完整呼叫延遲。
steps.checkEn: Separate allowed processors from actual placement, and compare kernel time with complete call latency.

quiz.question: 「處理器資格與映射」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Eligibility and placement: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 混合路徑4+3×2=10 ms，比9 ms更慢；這不是任何Apple裝置實測。
交付允許集合、實際映射、冷暖延遲、數值差異與裝置相容表。
若只首次很慢，檢查載入或編譯；若每次都慢，查轉換與邊界，不能直接歸咎神經引擎。
optionsEn: Heterogeneous time 4+3×2=10 ms, slower than9 ms; these are not Apple measurements.
Deliver eligible units, actual mapping, cold/warm latency, numerical differences and device compatibility.
A slow first call suggests loading/compilation; consistently slow calls suggest boundaries or conversion.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。若只首次很慢，檢查載入或編譯；若每次都慢，查轉換與邊界，不能直接歸咎神經引擎。 與本階段判準一起判讀：把允許使用某處理器與實際映射區分，對比核心時間及完整呼叫延遲。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. A slow first call suggests loading/compilation; consistently slow calls suggest boundaries or conversion. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Separate allowed processors from actual placement, and compare kernel time with complete call latency.

steps.title: 處理器資格與映射 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Eligibility and placement · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「處理器資格與映射」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Eligibility and placement and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若只首次很慢，檢查載入或編譯；若每次都慢，查轉換與邊界，不能直接歸咎神經引擎。
對照「處理器資格與映射」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。以代表工作負載選compute-units設定，保留CPU路徑供缺少特定處理器的裝置使用。
本階段必須重驗：把允許使用某處理器與實際映射區分，對比核心時間及完整呼叫延遲。
steps.instructionEn:
A slow first call suggests loading/compilation; consistently slow calls suggest boundaries or conversion.
Against the nominal Eligibility and placement result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Select allowed units using representative workloads, retaining CPU execution for unsupported devices.
Reverify this criterion: Separate allowed processors from actual placement, and compare kernel time with complete call latency.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若只首次很慢，檢查載入或編譯；若每次都慢，查轉換與邊界，不能直接歸咎神經引擎。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. A slow first call suggests loading/compilation; consistently slow calls suggest boundaries or conversion.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 把允許使用某處理器與實際映射區分，對比核心時間及完整呼叫延遲。
steps.checkEn: Separate allowed processors from actual placement, and compare kernel time with complete call latency.

steps.title: 處理器資格與映射 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Eligibility and placement · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「處理器資格與映射」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Eligibility and placement and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付允許集合、實際映射、冷暖延遲、數值差異與裝置相容表。
在交接件中加入「處理器資格與映射」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：把允許使用某處理器與實際映射區分，對比核心時間及完整呼叫延遲。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：把允許使用某處理器與實際映射區分，對比核心時間及完整呼叫延遲。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver eligible units, actual mapping, cold/warm latency, numerical differences and device compatibility.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Eligibility and placement: Separate allowed processors from actual placement, and compare kernel time with complete call latency.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Separate allowed processors from actual placement, and compare kernel time with complete call latency. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。把允許使用某處理器與實際映射區分，對比核心時間及完整呼叫延遲。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Separate allowed processors from actual placement, and compare kernel time with complete call latency.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.

steps.checkEn: Separate allowed processors from actual placement, and compare kernel time with complete call latency.
